notes: The patent names this as one of the herbicidal active ingredients to which transgenic plants are tolerant, so it is recorded rather than dropped, but imidazolinones is a compound class and not one substance: it denotes a whole herbicide family, so resolved is false. It is named only as a tolerance target in the transgenic-crops passage, not used in any step of this patent, hence role other and commercially_available false, a class not being a purchasable substance. Printed twice, lower case as imidazolinonen in the dative plural at the list of tolerated actives and capitalised as Imidazolinone in the IMI tolerance parenthesis; both printed forms are kept as aliases.

A specific herbicidal active, named as a tolerance target for transgenic plants and again in the Roundup Ready tolerance parenthesis, so resolved is true. German and English spelling coincide. Role other because no step of this patent uses it; commercially_available true as a bulk commodity herbicide that this document does not prepare. Roundup Ready is the trade name of the plants, not of this compound, and is not recorded.
